title: The pinned cfront and cc370 frontier
summary: The pinned ooRexx C++ source is adapted in a shadow tree, lowered through the patched cfront and fed to cc370 -S for S/370 assembler output. Dev15 reported 184/199 and dev16 reported 190/199 permitted core units; no later bulk sweep has been qualified.
invariants: Compiler source pins must match exact upstream Git HEAD; a dirty checkout is rejected by dev19 preflight.
199 permitted units exclude unrelated platform code, extensions, samples, and rexxapi; no claim of translating all upstream source.
Nonempty generated assembler is a host translation artifact, not a linkable executable guarantee.
The dev20 SJLJ cfront micro-probe does not clear any of the nine residual units.
Never destroy an earlier evidence directory until preflight passes; failed preflight must be non-destructive.
